The '''''Syalann''''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that was used by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]].

==History==
It served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of a Nagai [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]] during the conflict, and was nicknamed the '''Brute destroyer''' by the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]. Like other Nagai capital ships, it was named after a [[Syalann|city]] on [[Nagi/Legends|Nagi]].<ref name="TFW" />
